name: swasthyasetu-api
description: Cloud Run API for SwasthyaSetu AI federated healthcare platform

scripts.test:all: node smoke_test.js && node test_phc_update_bigquery.js && node test_read_bigquery.js
scripts.deploy: gcloud run deploy swasthyasetu-api --source . --project swasthyasetu-ai-7b4e6 --region us-central1 --allow-unauthenticated --port 8080 --min 0 --max 3 --memory 512Mi --set-env-vars GOOGLE_CLOUD_PROJECT=swasthyasetu-ai-7b4e6,BQ_DATASET=swasthya_ai,BQ_LOCATION=US
scripts.logs: gcloud run services logs read swasthyasetu-api --project swasthyasetu-ai-7b4e6 --region us-central1
